items.name: theme
items.title: flyingsalmon theme
items.description: Bold, warm, social. Bricolage Grotesque headings, Onest body, orange primary over an orange-50 beige page, 12px radius, light only.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion tokens
items.description: The motion language: duration constants and the spring-bounce / spring-settle presets every component animates with.

items.name: interaction
items.title: Interaction state classes
items.description: The rendering rules every interactive component shares: the disabled state, and the three focus ring geometries ADR 0003 defines. Geometry only — each component names its own ring color.

items.name: field
items.title: Field primitives
items.description: The wiring every field component shares: the label-to-control id linkage with its aria-describedby merge, the shared label variants, and the animated error message.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu item classes
items.description: The item, highlight, destructive, icon-slot, label, separator, and panel class strings shared by every floating list of actions or values, fixed in the dropdown-menu spec (#52).

items.name: floating
items.title: Floating layer motion
items.description: The enter and exit keyframes and --animate-* variables every floating component shares: anchored content, the dialog panel, the drawer panel, and the scrim. CSS only, per ADR 0005.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The loading primitive for action busyness. One variant, two sizes, a currentColor arc rotating once per 800ms.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The action component. Six variants, four sizes, and a loading state that morphs the button around its own spinner while it stays focused and reachable.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: The app's inline vehicle for the result of an action. A neutral surface where the icon carries the variant, two sizes, an optional close button, and its own enter and exit animation.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field that owns its label, error message, and busyness. Text-like types only; stays editable while loading.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multiline text field that owns its label, error message, and busyness. Autosizes between a row floor and a row cap; stays editable while loading.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An instant-apply on/off control that owns its label and its own busyness. One size, no variants, no error state; a failed toggle is a result the app shows.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A tri-state checkbox that owns its label and error message. One 20px size; the check mark morphs into a dash for the indeterminate state.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A static marker for a status, a category, or a small count. Six variants, one size, never focusable and never animated.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: The identity mark for a person. Image, then two initials on one of eight step-400 hues, then a plain circle. Static and non-focusable.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A flat container that groups related content on one surface. Seven slots, one padding step, no variants; `interactive` opts into hover, press, and focus feedback through a stretched title link.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: The region-loading placeholder. Three shape presets sized by the consumer, pulsing on a 2s cycle, always hidden from assistive technology.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal surface over a scrim. It traps focus, locks scroll, and returns focus to its trigger on close.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A modal menu of actions anchored to its trigger. Arrow keys walk the items; choosing one closes the menu.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A single-select field that owns its label and error message. The list is a modal surface anchored to the trigger.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A non-modal label anchored to its trigger. It never takes focus, and pointer leave, blur, or Escape dismisses it.

items.name: icon-tooltip
items.title: Icon Tooltip
items.description: A focusable icon named by its tooltip text. Keyboard focus and hover open the tooltip, and the icon stays reachable inside a row whose whole surface is a link.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A horizontal tab set in one underline variant. A sliding indicator tracks the selected tab; a separate bar marks focus.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A layout shell. It gives fields their vertical rhythm, an actions row, and an optional slot where the app places the submit result as an alert.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A single choice from a small set of visible options, in one 20px size. It owns its label and error message like the rest of the field family; the checked item fills primary with a knocked-out dot that fades in.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A styled primitive for tabular data in seven parts: Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHeadCell, and TableCell. Horizontal rules only, a primary header rule, a background step on the hovered body row, and an interactive row whose single link stretches over the whole row. Sorting, selection, and pagination belong to a data table built on top.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Progressive disclosure in a divider list: a heading row opens its own panel on a height animation. Several items open at once by default; type single with collapsible gives a one-item disclosure.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: An overlapping row of avatars with an overflow count past a limit. Hover or keyboard focus parts the row around one avatar until it stands free and reveals its name; the chip reveals the names it hides.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A one-pixel rule that divides content, horizontal or vertical. Decorative by default, announced only when the division carries meaning.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a single date or a range. It draws the days and owns selection; the trigger, the panel, and the field wiring belong to date-picker.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A field that opens a calendar in a panel and posts the chosen dates. It owns its label, error, and trigger like the rest of the field family; the grid inside is calendar.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A text field that opens a panel of the items the app supplies for the current text, taking one value or several as chips, with typed text allowed as a value. It owns its label and error like the rest of the field family; it never filters, fetches, or debounces.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: A numeric field with a unit, bounds, and a step. It owns its label and error like the rest of the field family.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of chips that toggle in single or multiple mode, wrapping across rows. Single mode returns to empty, multiple mode takes a max, and required blocks the last deselect. No shared track and no tab shape: each chip is its own control.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar for an operation of known length, determinate or indeterminate. Spinner covers an action's busyness and skeleton covers a loading region; progress covers measured work.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A bar of equal segments filled through the current one, for a position in a sequence of known count. It reads as ticks rather than a fraction; progress covers one operation of known length.

items.name: notice
items.title: Notice
items.description: One persistent message for a result with no visible home, dismissed by the user and never by a timer. It links back to its subject and never takes focus.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A resting no-content block: an optional icon, a required title, an optional description, and one or two actions. Two sizes, no variants, and no border or background of its own.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An aside with header, content, and footer slots that morphs between an expanded column and an icon rail, and becomes one sticky horizontal strip under a 700px container. It hosts navigation items or any other rail content.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A horizontal scroll-snap track with previous and next controls. Items keep their own width; the carousel owns the snapping and the keyboard path.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A sequence of markers joined by a connector. Content sits beside its marker; meaning stays with the consumer.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A modal panel inset at the right edge of the viewport for secondary content that accompanies the page still visible beside it: filters for a list, the detail of a selected row. It is dialog's root and parts with one panel of its own, and it is never app navigation and never a confirm.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail showing where the current page sits in a hierarchy. Every level above the current one links back up; the current page is plain text.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: One controlled control that moves between the numbered pages of a list or table: previous, a seven-slot window of page numbers with an ellipsis for every run of at least two hidden pages, and next. A compact form reads "Page 3 of 12" instead. Page size and the range line stay with the app.

items.name: text-link
items.title: Text Link
items.description: An anchor for a sentence or a line of UI copy. It takes its size and weight from the text around it and carries an underline that never leaves; a link navigates and a button acts.
